practice_goals.title: Reduce Average Deployment Timeline by 20%
practice_goals.description: Through standardized methodology, reusable assets, and accelerators, reduce the average Workday Finance full-suite deployment from 26 weeks to 20 weeks by end of FY2026.
success_criteria: Average Finance full-suite deployment drops from 26 to ≤20 weeks across new client engagements starting H2 2026
At least 3 projects complete within the 20-week target before EOY 2026
Timeline reduction measured and tracked via the CoP delivery tracker (actuals vs. baseline)
composition: Integration template library reduces Studio build time by eliminating from-scratch development
Conversion Methodology V2 speeds data preparation and reduces field mapping analysis time
Standard financial report packages eliminate custom build time for the most common Finance reports
CoP-managed cutover toolkit reduces go-live prep and rehearsal planning overhead
Workday Extend reusable application templates reduce custom app development cycles
how_to_achieve: Publish and enforce the standard CoP deployment methodology across all Finance projects
Build and catalog 50+ reusable integration templates in the CoP asset library
Train all consultants on CoP accelerators and require their use on new engagements
Track actuals vs. target weekly via project health reports submitted to CoP
Conduct quarterly retrospectives on timeline performance and update methodology accordingly
requirements: Methodology adoption must reach ≥80% before timeline reduction is measurable at scale
All 4 sub-agent areas must contribute reusable, deployment-ready assets
Project managers must log actual deployment durations in the CoP delivery tracker
Asset library must contain published assets for all major Finance deployment phases

practice_goals.title: Achieve 90% Methodology Adoption Rate
practice_goals.description: Ensure 90% of all active Workday Finance projects follow the standard CoP deployment methodology by Q3 2026.
success_criteria: 90% of active Finance projects score ≥80% on the 20-point CoP methodology checklist
Measurement taken at kickoff, mid-project, and go-live milestones for each engagement
Non-compliant projects are identified and remediation is in progress within 2 weeks of audit
composition: Kickoff alignment: use of CoP project charter and scoping template on day one
Execution: use of CoP integration, conversion, and reporting templates during delivery
Governance: weekly status report submitted to CoP in standard format
Go-live: cutover rehearsal conducted per CoP protocol (minimum 2 dress rehearsals)
Retrospective: post-go-live lesson capture submitted within 2 weeks of go-live
how_to_achieve: Train all project teams on the CoP methodology at engagement kickoff
Embed a methodology compliance checklist into project governance reviews
Publish methodology guides for all 4 focus areas (Integrations, Conversion, Reporting, Extend)
Identify and remediate non-adopting projects through quarterly CoP audits
Recognize high-adoption projects in CoP meetings to drive cultural buy-in
requirements: Published methodology guides must exist for all 4 focus areas before enforcement begins
Methodology audit scorecard tool must be deployed and accessible to all project leads
Leadership mandate for CoP compliance on all Finance projects
CoP Manager must have visibility into all active Finance engagements

practice_goals.title: Deploy 10 AI Use Cases to Clients
practice_goals.description: Identify, build, and deploy at least 10 production AI use cases for Workday Financials across client base by end of FY2026.
success_criteria: 10 distinct AI use cases in production at client sites by December 31, 2026
Each deployed use case is actively used and generates measurable, documented client value
At least 3 different focus areas (Integrations, Extend, Reporting) are represented across deployments
composition: AI Invoice Processing & Exception Routing — Workday Extend + Claude API (in development)
AI Financial Anomaly Detection — Prism Analytics + Python ML (deployed at Client C)
AI Integration Error Diagnostics — Claude API + Studio logs (in development)
Natural Language Financial Query (Ask Workday) — Claude API + RaaS (in development)
AI Supplier Risk Scoring — Claude API + Workday AP (planning)
AI Conversion Data Mapping Assistant — Claude API + Python (planning)
Expense Policy AI Compliance Reviewer — Claude API + Workday Extend (in development)
Workday Address & Banking Data Validator — Flask + pandas (deployed, 2 clients)
2+ additional use cases to be identified through client engagements in H2 2026
how_to_achieve: Complete internal build and QA of all 8 AI solutions currently in the pipeline
Pilot 2–3 use cases at client sites in Q2–Q3 2026 with structured feedback loops
Present AI capabilities in client QBRs and include in proposal responses
Package each use case with a deployment guide, ROI calculator, and client pitch deck
Track deployment progress in the AI Pipeline view of this dashboard
requirements: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY procurement and client-side approval for AI-powered solutions
Client data sharing agreements for solutions operating on client data
Internal security review and validation of each use case before client deployment
Client-ready packaging: deployment guide, data requirements, and support model defined

practice_goals.title: Achieve 95% Cutover Success Rate
practice_goals.description: Zero rollbacks on go-live cutovers through improved pre-cutover testing frameworks and rehearsal protocols.
success_criteria: Zero rollbacks within 72 hours of go-live on any Workday Finance deployment
95% of cutovers complete within the planned maintenance window
Post-cutover data defect rate below 5% of migrated records (measured at T+5 business days)
composition: Pre-cutover rehearsal protocol (minimum 2 full dress rehearsals required per project)
Automated data validation framework (pre-load and post-load automated checks)
Go-live command center setup with a documented decision-authority matrix
Rollback plan documented, approved, and tested before cutover weekend
Post-cutover monitoring checklist (T+1, T+3, T+5 checkpoints with sign-off)
how_to_achieve: Mandate 2 full dress rehearsals per the CoP Cutover Playbook before any go-live
Automate pre-load and post-load data validation using the CoP Validation Framework
Publish and enforce the Cutover Decision Authority Matrix on all projects
Conduct post-go-live retrospectives and feed findings back into the cutover playbook
Build a shared lessons-learned database for cutover issues and resolutions
requirements: CoP Cutover Toolkit must be published and accessible to all project teams
Automated Data Validation Framework must be deployed (linked to Conversion sub-goal)
All cutover leads must be trained and signed off on the CoP rehearsal protocol
Post-go-live retrospective must be completed and submitted within 2 weeks of go-live

Workday Extend application templates reused per Extend delivery stream
Document templates (IDD, SDD, cutover playbook) reused on every project

Make assets discoverable via the CoP Asset Library (Assets view in this dashboard)
Require asset reuse documentation in project governance reviews
Incentivize asset contributions through a CoP recognition and acknowledgment program
Retire outdated assets and replace with updated versions after each deployment
requirements: Asset library must be populated with ≥75 published, deployment-ready assets
Assets must be tagged, searchable, and include deployment guides or usage notes
Project leads must log asset usage in the CoP delivery tracker
Asset quality review process must be in place before assets are promoted to 'published'
